clauses.requirement: Rear position lamp (UN R48 para 6.10.9, Other requirements): no other requirements apply; none are specified for the rear position lamp beyond those in the preceding paragraphs of 6.10.

Rear fog lamp (UN R48 para 6.11, heading of the individual specifications): where a rear fog lamp is fitted, it shall meet the specifications of paragraphs 6.11.1 to 6.11.4 and subparagraphs (presence, number, arrangement, position). The product spec does not list a rear fog lamp function, so this applies only if one is incorporated.

Rear fog lamp presence (UN R48 para 6.11.1): devices of category F, F1 or F2 are mandatory on the vehicle. This applies to the product only if a rear fog lamp function is used or incorporated in the rear lamp.

Rear fog lamp number (UN R48 para 6.11.2): one or two rear fog lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 38, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148. This applies if a rear fog lamp is incorporated.
Rear fog lamp arrangement (UN R48 para 6.11.3): no special requirement applies to the arrangement of the rear fog lamp, if one is incorporated.
Rear fog lamp position (UN R48 para 6.11.4, heading): the rear fog lamp, if fitted, shall be positioned in accordance with the width requirement of 6.11.4.1 and the height requirement of 6.11.4.2.

Rear fog lamp position in width (UN R48 para 6.11.4.1): if there is only one rear fog lamp, it shall be on the opposite side of the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle to the direction of traffic prescribed in the country of registration; the centre of reference may also be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle. Applies if a rear fog lamp is incorporated.

Rear fog lamp position in height (UN R48 para 6.11.4.2): the rear fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,000 mm above the ground; for rear fog lamps grouped with any rear lamp the maximum height may be increased to 1,200 mm; for categories N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm. Applies if a rear fog lamp is incorporated.
